channel.title: The Imaginal Door
channel.description: Imagine the end. Live from it. Calm, hour-long explorations of Neville Goddard and the Law of Assumption: assuming the feeling of the wish fulfilled, living in the end, and letting your inner world reshape the outer one. Educational and inspirational only.
channel.itunes:author: The Imaginal Door

item.title: Awareness Is The Door | Law of Assumption
item.description:
The Power of Awareness is not a motivational idea. It is Neville Goddard’s exact doorway into conscious creation: the discovery that what you call “I” is not trapped inside the facts of life, but is the power assigning meaning, identity, and future to those facts.
In this deep-dive, you will learn ten precise ways to work with awareness tonight: how to separate yourself from the old state, move into a chosen state, pray from possession, discipline attention, revise the unseen cause, and let imagination become the only evidence you obey.

item.title: Stop Loving From Absence | Law of Assumption
item.description:
The person you want is not kept away by distance, silence, timing, or the outer story. In Neville Goddard’s language, the deeper mistake is remaining inwardly as the one who is still outside love, still waiting to be chosen, still measuring reality from the old state.
This 1-hour teaching walks through 10 Neville-based lessons for returning to the self-concept that love can meet. Not by chasing, controlling, or forcing another person, but by entering the fulfilled state so completely that your inner world stops arguing with the desire.

item.title: Come Home Before Life Changes | Law of Assumption
item.description:
The prodigal son is not only a story about distance, regret, and forgiveness. Read through Neville Goddard’s teaching, it becomes a precise map of consciousness: the far country is a state, the famine is an assumption, and the Father’s house is the fulfilled awareness you return to before the world gives evidence.
In this one-hour deep dive, you will learn how to stop wandering in the old identity, revise the inner exile, enter the robe-and-ring state before sleep, quiet the elder brother within, and live as the one already received by life.

item.title: Decide From The Finished Life | Law of Assumption
item.description:
A big decision is not solved by fear counting every possible road. In Neville Goddard’s teaching, the outer choice becomes clear when you first enter the inner end — the state of the one for whom the decision has already become peace.
This deep-dive teaches how to decide from imagination, not panic. You will learn how to build a fulfilled scene, quiet the old state, revise the fear around choosing, use inner conversations, sleep past the crossroads, and let action be born from the self who has already arrived.

item.title: The Feeling That Writes Reality | Law of Assumption
item.description:
Neville Goddard did not teach desire as wishing. He taught desire as an inner fact accepted by feeling, impressed upon the deeper mind, and quietly expressed through life.
This video reads the heart of Feeling Is the Secret as a living practice: consciousness, feeling, prayer, sleep, the subconscious, and the discipline of becoming the one who already is answered before the world agrees.

item.title: Outlive The Opposite | Law of Assumption
item.description:
When the world keeps showing you the very thing you no longer want, the test is not whether imagination is working. The test is whether you will let old evidence rename you.
This 1-hour Law of Assumption deep dive teaches how to remain faithful when facts look reversed: how to read circumstances, revise the day, enter the fulfilled state, quiet inner conversations, and sleep as the one whose desire is already real within.

item.title: The Body Hears Your State | Law of Assumption
item.description:
This is a deep Neville Goddard meditation on imagining your body well again — not as forced positivity, not as denial, but as a disciplined return to the state of wholeness before the outer facts have finished rearranging themselves.
Across ten quiet lessons, you will learn how to use SATS, revision, prayer, inner conversation, feeling, and the bare I AM to stop living as the frightened observer of the body and begin occupying the self who already knows ease as natural.

item.title: Gratitude Before It Appears | Law of Assumption
item.description:
Gratitude, in Neville Goddard’s teaching, is not polite optimism. It is the quiet inner signature of the wish fulfilled — the feeling that the unseen has already been accepted as real.
This one-hour deep dive teaches ten Neville-based ways to use gratitude as an imaginal discipline: not journaling, not begging, not chasing signs, but entering the state where “thank you” becomes natural because you are already living from the answer.

item.title: Trust The Unseen Bridge | Law of Assumption
item.description:
When you keep asking how it will happen, you quietly leave the fulfilled state and return to the old courtroom of doubt. Neville Goddard taught that imagination does not need visible machinery before it can become fact; it needs inner occupancy, faithfulness, and the courage to stop managing the bridge.
In this deep-dive, you will learn ten Neville-based inner disciplines for releasing the desperate need to figure everything out. Not by becoming passive. Not by pretending you do not care. But by entering the end so completely that the way can arrange itself without your frightened supervision.

item.title: Change The Voice Within | Law of Assumption
item.description:
Your life is not only shaped by what you say aloud. It is shaped by the conversations you keep holding in secret — the arguments, apologies, rehearsals, defenses, and imagined replies you return to when no one is watching.
In this deep Neville Goddard teaching, you will learn how to change the inner conversations you live by: not through forced positivity, not by chasing signs, but by occupying the state whose voice already sounds like fulfillment.

item.title: Let Failure Lose Your Name | Law of Assumption
item.description:
You failed once. Maybe more than once. But Neville Goddard did not teach failure as a final fact. He taught states, assumptions, imagination, and the quiet art of becoming inwardly faithful to a different end before the world has any reason to agree.
This 1-hour deep dive is for the weary seeker who has tried surface manifestation and now wants the real inner discipline: how to stop wearing failure as identity, enter the state of the second chance, and let imagination become the place where life begins again.

item.title: Arrive Already Crowned | Law of Assumption
item.description:
The big moment does not begin when the door opens. It begins in the silent chamber of imagination, where you either enter as someone waiting to be judged or as someone whose end has already been accepted.
In this one-hour Law of Assumption deep dive, you will learn ten Neville Goddard principles for interviews, conversations, launches, meetings, auditions, presentations, and turning points — not by forcing the outer world, but by occupying the inner state that the outer world must eventually answer.

item.title: Let Sleep Believe It First | Law of Assumption
item.description:
This is not another lesson on forcing your desire, chasing signs, or trying to think positively until the outer world obeys. This is a deep Neville Goddard meditation on the state akin to sleep — the quiet threshold where the outer senses fade, the old identity loosens, and imagination can be accepted as fact.
Tonight, you will learn how to enter the fulfilled state without strain, build an imaginal scene that feels owned rather than wished for, and fall asleep as the person for whom the desire is no longer a question. The work is subtle. The change begins where effort ends.

item.title: Heal The Family Within | Law of Assumption
item.description:
What if the hardest family relationship is not repaired by chasing an apology, winning an argument, or proving how deeply you were hurt — but by entering a new inner room where you are no longer the wounded version of yourself?
In this 1-hour Law of Assumption deep dive, we explore 10 Neville Goddard-based lessons for healing a painful family bond through revision, inner conversations, self-concept, imaginal prayer, and the discipline of remaining faithful to a new state before the outer world confirms it.

item.title: Borrow Tomorrow’s Calm | Law of Assumption
item.description:
Anxiety tells you that peace must wait until life proves itself safe. Neville Goddard taught the opposite: consciousness moves first, and the world follows the state you consent to occupy.
In this deep Law of Assumption meditation, you will learn ten precise inner practices for exchanging nervous rehearsal for assumed calm — not by denying desire, chasing signs, or forcing outcomes, but by entering the quiet authority of the wish fulfilled.

item.title: Let Work Recognize You | Law of Assumption
item.description:
This is a deep Neville Goddard meditation on work, calling, and the inner state that quietly precedes outer placement. Not work as pressure. Not work as proof. Work that feels like your nature finally being given a room.
Across these ten lessons, you will learn how to assume the inner occupation, feel the function beneath the title, revise old work wounds, soften the employer into a witness, and fall asleep as the one already placed in meaningful contribution.

item.title: Revise The Scene That Still Hurts | Law of Assumption
item.description:
A painful memory can feel like a sealed room in the mind: one scene, one sentence, one look on someone’s face, replaying as if it still has authority over who you are. Neville Goddard taught that imagination is not escape from life but the creative power by which life is inwardly reordered.
In this deep revision practice, you will learn ten distinct ways to approach the memory you cannot forget: not by denying what happened, not by forcing forgiveness, and not by waiting for time to heal it, but by moving into a new inner fact until the old scene loses its throne. This is for the weary seeker who is ready to stop worshiping the wound and begin occupying the self who is free.

item.title: Become The One Life Answers | Law of Assumption
item.description:
You are not trying to become someone more impressive. You are learning how to accept the self that consciousness has already prepared, and how to live from that state before the world has caught up.
This hour is for the person who has outgrown surface manifestation and is ready for Neville’s deeper discipline: assumption, inner speech, revision, naturalness, and the quiet authority of the imaginal act. Not chasing signs. Not forcing people. Becoming the one who no longer needs permission to be real.

item.title: You Were Never Outside | Law of Assumption
item.description:
If you have tried to belong by becoming more impressive, more available, or easier to love, this hour turns you back to the place Neville kept pointing toward: the state you occupy in consciousness. Loneliness is not treated as a verdict. It is treated as a state that can be left.
Across ten teachings, you will practice the inner address, the invested thought, the expected state, ordered inner conversations, and the felt unity beneath every separate face. The method draws on Neville’s teachings on consciousness as cause, changing self rather than others, states, inner talking, and the “I AM” as the first principle. ([Real Neville][1])

item.title: The Desire Isn't Late | Law of Assumption
item.description:
For the wish that feels deaf, delayed, or impossibly far away, this video returns to Neville Goddard’s real discipline: imagination as the only creative power, assumption as inner identity, and faithfulness to the unseen when the senses keep saying nothing has changed.
These ten lessons are not surface manifestation tactics. They are a one-hour descent into the state beneath the wanting — how to stop living as the one waiting, how to enter the unseen fulfillment with precision, and how to let the desire become natural before life has rearranged itself.

item.title: Change The Mirror, Not The Person | Law of Assumption
item.description:
You cannot remake another person by watching them, pleading with them, or silently arguing with their old version. Neville Goddard’s radical teaching was quieter and sharper: the outer world answers the state you occupy, and other people meet the self you have consented to be.
In this 1-hour deep dive, we use Neville’s actual principles — everyone is you pushed out, revision, inner conversations, SATS, living from the fulfilled state, and the feeling of naturalness — to explore how relationships change when you stop trying to manage the mirror and begin changing the one who is looking.

item.title: Stop Auditioning for Your Own Life | Law of Assumption
item.description:
You were never meant to earn your right to exist through applause, achievement, usefulness, or another person’s response. This hour returns self-worth to Neville’s deeper ground: the difference between the eternal occupant and a temporary state.
Through ten connected practices, you will learn to read your reactions, imagine from within, catch the mood beneath praise, use the law of least action, train attention, release shame without evading responsibility, and seal one quiet scene of self-respect before sleep.

item.title: Be The One Love Comes Home To | Law of Assumption
item.description:
This is a one-hour Neville Goddard deep dive for the person who still loves someone, still feels the unfinished ache, and yet knows chasing has only kept the old story alive. The work is not to force another human being, but to enter the state where love is no longer an emergency.
Across these ten lessons, you will learn how to stop occupying rejection, build imaginal scenes that imply reunion without controlling the path, hear inner conversations from fulfillment, release second causes, enter the Sabbath, and let self-concept become the place where love can meet you again.

item.title: Stop Asking Money If You Are Safe | Law of Assumption
item.description:
Money fear is rarely only about money. It is the quiet inner habit of asking life for proof that you are safe, chosen, supported, and allowed to rest.
In this deep Neville Goddard teaching, you will learn ten distinct ways to work with imagination when lack has become your private atmosphere: moving into the state, revising the old money story, praying from fulfillment, sleeping as the one who is provided for, and remaining faithful before the outer world agrees.
